programme.desc: Mohan falls in love with Gouri. Later, Gouri learns that her friend Shyama also loves Mohan and decides to sacrifice her love for Shyama.

programme.title: Ghar Ka Chirag
programme.desc: A wealthy widower marries the daughter of a school principal when her lover is assumed dead. Five years later, her lover returns and sets out to find the truth behind her marriage.

programme.title: An Evening In Paris
programme.desc: A wealthy woman meets a charming but not completely truthful beau in France.

programme.title: Apne Paraye
programme.desc: This is a story of two lawyer brothers, their half brother, their wives and children.

programme.title: Jurrat
programme.desc: Inspector Avinash is transferred to Mumbai and is tasked to nab smuggler Kama Seth. When Kama hoodwinks Avinash and makes him a laughing stock in the eyes of the media, he makes a dangerous decision.

programme.title: Ek Chadar Maili Si
programme.desc: When Ranno's husband Trilok dies, her life and family slowly start to fall apart. How will her family recover.

programme.title: Justice Choudhary
programme.desc: Justice Chowdhary gives up his moral values and determines to seek revenge after his entire family is abducted and killed in his presence.

programme.title: Na Tum Jaano Na Hum
programme.desc: A romantically inclined couple decide to get to know each other through letters without disclosing their identities.

programme.title: Pablo
programme.desc: Mae gan Pablo ei ffordd ei hun o weld y byd a heddiw mae'n mynd ar ei wyliau. Flying is fun, but the airport is a bit overwhelming. The animals help Pablo work out exactly what he must do.

programme.title: Twt
programme.desc: Mae 'Rhen Gerwyn yn mwynhau sôn am ei anturiaethau ar y môr ac yn codi ofn ar Twt wrth sôn am fwystfilod môr. Twt doesn't believe in sea monsters but will he change his mind.

programme.title: Blero'n Mynd i Ocido
programme.desc: Mae brêc fflôt carnifal Maer Oci wedi torri.Mae Blero a'i ffrindiau'n trio dal y fflôt. The breaks on Mayor Oci's carnival float have broken.and Blero tries to stop the runaway float.

programme.title: Kim a Cêt a Twrch
programme.desc: Mae ein stori ni'n dechrau yn y goedwig. Tra'n mynd am dro, mae Kim a Cêt yn dod o hyd i Twrch. Our story begins in the forest. While going for a walk, Kim and Cêt find Twrch.

programme.title: Blwi
programme.desc: Mae Mam yn mynd i barti 'baby shower' felly Dad sy'n gyfrifol am y merched heno. When Mum goes out for the evening,Dad takes charge of the girls' evening routine.

programme.title: Joni Jet
programme.desc: Mae Cwstenin Cranc isho dal y sgodyn cnau mwnci fwy na mae o isho cysgu ac ma Joni'n dysgu bod pawb angen seibiant! Cwstenin Cranc wants to catch the peanut fish more than he wants to sleep.

programme.title: A i Y Awyr Iach
programme.desc: 's' am sglefr fyrddio ac 's' am syrffio. Today's letter is S: 's' for 'sglefr fyrddio' (skateboarding) and 'syrffio' (surfing).

programme.title: Ger a Gu
programme.desc: Mae hi'n boeth! Mor boeth fel bod cystadleuaeth cestyll tywod Porthoer wedi'i chanslo! It's hot! So hot that the annual Porthore sandcastle contest is cancelled.

programme.title: Parc Glan Gwil
programme.desc: Mae hi'n amser Eisteddfod Parc Glan Gwil ac mae Sioned Siop am gystadlu. Mae angen dysgu sut i ddawnsio disgo! It's time for the Parc Glan Gwil Eisteddfod & Sioned Siop wants to compete.

programme.title: Caru Canu
programme.desc: Anturiaethau dau gi annwyl a drygionus sydd yn y gân draddodiadol hon. This traditional Welsh song follows two sweet and mischievous dogs on their adventures.

programme.title: Yr Whws
programme.desc: Mae'r castell tywod gododd yr Whws ddoe wedi diflannu, mae nhw'n dysgu am y môr a'r llanw. The sandcastle which the Woohoos made yesterday has disappeared, they learn how this happens.

programme.title: Ein Byd Bach...
programme.desc: Yn y bennod yma byddwn yn dysgu am bopeth sy'n ymwneud â cheir, ac ewn i Unol Daleithiau America i ddysgu am Henry Ford. In this episode we'll learn about cars.

programme.title: Guto Gwningen
programme.desc: Mae Guto a'i ffrindiau'n gollwng llaeth Meri Mew ac mae nhw ar frys i'w roi yn ôl. Guto and his friends accidentally spill Meri Mew's milk,they launch a daring mission to replace it.

programme.title: Dal Dy Ddannedd
programme.desc: Timau o Ysgol Bro Eirwg sy'n ymuno â Pwdryn a Melys i chwarae llond trol o gemau lliwgar! Teams from Ysgol Bro Eirwg join Pwdryn and Melys to play a series of candyland themed games.

programme.title: Ne-wff-ion
programme.desc: y diweddara am hanes Teigr sy wedi bod ar goll a hanes Ffosil Lili ar draeth Y Barri. Story of a Tiger that has been lost and the history of Fossil Lili on Barry beach.

programme.title: Cymylaubychain
programme.desc: Mae'r Cymulaubychain a Seren Fach yn cael trafferth cysgu. Mae 'na swn rhyfedd yn eu cadw'n effro. Sut mae rhoi taw arno? The friends are having trouble sleeping because of a loud noise.

programme.title: Help Llaw
programme.desc: Mae Harriet wedi archebu cacen arbennig ar gyfer penblwydd Nain Help Llaw yn 100 oed, ond mae popty'r pobydd wedi torri! Harriet has ordered a special cake, but the baker's oven is broken.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: Mae pont Swopdre Fawr ar fin dymchwel - a fydd Mojo a Bo yn gallu helpu Nori ei thrwsio mewn pryd? Swoppiton Bridge is falling down, can Mojo and Bo help Nori fix a girder in time.

programme.title: Annibendod
programme.desc: Mae Gwyneth wedi gweu siwmper i Maldwyn ond ma'r plant yn credu ei fod yn siwtio bwgan brain yn well. Gwyneth has knitted a jumper for Maldwyn but the kids think it better suits scarecrow.

programme.title: Y Tralalas
programme.desc: Mae Harmoni, Melodi a Bop yn cael hwyl yn dringo i ben y mynydd. Mae cymaint i'w weld a'i arogli yma. Harmoni, Melodi and Bop have the best time climbing to the top of the mountain.

programme.title: Pablo
programme.desc: Heddiw mae 'na gardigan oren sy'n edrych yn ddychrynllyd iawn. Mae'r anifeiliaid i gyd ofn y bwystfil hefyd, heblaw am Lona, sydd mor ddewr a llew. There's a scary monster in Pablo's room.

programme.title: Twt

programme.title: Kim a Cêt a Twrch
programme.desc: Mae Kim a Cêt yn rhyddhau'r synau o'r peiriant - ond mae'r synau yn mynd yn ôl i'r anifeiliaid anghywir! Kim and Cêt release the animal sounds - but they go back to the wrong animals.

programme.title: Blwi

programme.desc: 1953. Thriller. Directed by Vernon Sewell. Starring Hazel Court & Dermot Walsh. A young couple decide to buy a luxury steamboat for a romantic getaway and scoff at warnings that it's haunted.

programme.title: None But the Tortoise
programme.desc: A short documentary from 1966 detailing the car crowded roads of London and the changes that have come into play to make the roads more efficient.

programme.title: The Man from U.N.C.L.E
programme.desc: The Birds and the Bees Affair. 1966. Stars Robert Vaughn, David McCallum & Ahna Capri. THRUSH has developed a strain of tiny but deadly bees and plans to release them in U.N.C.L.E. HQ in New York.

programme.title: Hannay
programme.desc: The Fellowship of the Black Stone. 1988. Stars Robert Powell, Christopher Scoular & Gavin Richards. Hannay is recognised as an officer in military intelligence, an engineer & a prospector.

programme.title: Bellman and True
programme.desc: 1987. Thriller. Directed by Richard Loncraine. Stars Bernard Jill, Derek Newark & Richard Hope. A computer expert is forced to use his scientific genius to pull off a daring bank heist.

programme.title: The Comic
programme.desc: 1969. Comedy/Drama. Directed by Carl Reiner. Stars Dick Van Dyke, Michele Lee & Mickey Rooney. The intriguing story of an exceptional silent-film comic whose talent is overshadowed by his ego.

programme.title: Breathless
programme.desc: 1960. Drama. Director: Jean-Luc Godard. Stars Jean-Paul Belmondo, Jean Seberg & Jean-Luc Godard. A small-time crook attempts to persuade a student to run away with him to Italy.

programme.title: Talking Pictures With Anita Harris
programme.desc: Anita Harris discusses her love of film, theatre & music. What working with the 'Carry On Team' was like & her memories of Harry Secombe, Frankie Howerd & Phil Silvers. Presented by Robert Ross.

programme.title: The Directors
programme.desc: Billy Wilder, From Greta Garbo's Ninotchka, film noir classic Double Indemnity to his academy award winning classics Lost Weekend, Sunset Boulevard and The Apartment.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: 1966. Stars Adam West, Liberace & Marilyn Hanold. Batman and Robin must stop a nefarious concert pianist who's plotting to kill Bruce and marry Aunt Harriet.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: 1966. Stars Adam West, Liberace & Burt Ward. Batman and Robin escape Chandell's trap and plot to outsmart him and put a stop to his malicious plan.

programme.title: Third Party Risk
programme.desc: 1955. Crime. Directed by Daniel Birt. Stars Lloyd Bridges, Finlay Currie & Maureen Swanson. A man holidaying in Spain becomes inadvertently mixed up in a case of murder and microfilm smuggling.

programme.title: Impulse
programme.desc: 1955. Drama. Directed by Charles De la Tour & Cy Endfield. Stars Arthur Kennedy, Constance Smith & Joy Shelton. A night club singer tricks an estate agent into thinking he killed a jewel thief.

programme.title: Hammer The Toff
programme.desc: 1952. Crime Drama by Maclean Rogers. The Toff (John Bentley) tries to help Susan (Patricia Dainton) reunite with her uncle who's been targeted by criminals that are after his steel formula.

programme.title: Great Day In The Morning
programme.desc: 1956. Western. A gambler wins a hotel in a card game but finds himself involved with women and the start of the civil war. Starring Robert Stack, Virginia Mayo & Ruth Roman.

programme.title: Four Star Playhouse: Let The Chips Fall
programme.desc: Stars Charles Boyer, Rhys Williams & Jean Willes. A reformed card sharp is enlisted to unmask a suspected poker cheat among a group of wealthy gamblers.

programme.title: The Buccaneers
programme.desc: 1957. Stars Robert Shaw, Virginia Maskell & Marne Maitland. Whilst Tempest sails to Charleston, he encounters a strange woman alone in a boat at sea who tells him a peculiar story.

programme.title: Doctor In Distress
programme.desc: 1963. Comedy. Directed by Ralph Thomas. Stars Dirk Bogarde, James Robertson Justice & Samantha Eggar. Dr. Simon Sparrow's love life improves when the lovely Delia Mallory is brought into casualty.

programme.title: Four Star Playhouse: The Lost Silk Hat
programme.desc: Stars Ronald Colman, Richard Whorf & Jay Novello. After a lovers' quarrel and a vow to never return, a man realises he has left behind his silk hat. How will he retrieve it.

programme.title: What's On TPTV With Noel
programme.desc: Founder of Talking Pictures TV and one half of the Footage Detectives, Noel Cronin, shares shows and films not to be missed throughout November.

programme.title: Scandal Sheet
programme.desc: 1952. Crime. Directed by Phil Karlson. Stars John Derek, Donna Reed & Broderick Crawford. A newspaper editor accidentally kills his ex-wife and his protégé is assigned to investigate the story.

programme.title: Rooms
programme.desc: Miss Peebles and Mr Busby Pt1. Stars Graham Crowden, Anne Stallybrass and Sylvia Kay. Mr Busby, an eccentric elderly tenant, is accused of stealing from Miss Peebles.

programme.title: Rooms
programme.desc: Miss Peebles and Mr Busby Pt2. Stars Graham Crowden, Anne Stallybrass and Sylvia Kay. Miss Peebles patience wears thin with Mr Busby upstairs.

programme.title: Out of Town
programme.desc: 1986. Lock, stock and barrel Jack explains the working of his great-grandfather's shotgun. Then he visits a shooting school on a disused railway line.

programme.title: Dick Turpin
programme.desc: 1979. Stars Richard O'Sullivan, Kevin Brennan, David Daker. Dick takes pity on an unimpressive suitor, when the wealthy Phyllida is arranged to marry, helping to unite the young lovers.

programme.title: Van der Valk
programme.desc: Stars Barry Foster, Michael Latimer & Susan Travers. Van der Valk searches for a teenage girl abducted on her way to a clandestine rendezvous with a married man.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes: Murder by Decree
programme.desc: 1979. Crime. Director: Bob Clark. Stars: Christopher Plummer, James Mason & David Hemmings. Holmes investigates Jack the Ripper's murders and discovers a conspiracy to protect the killer.

programme.title: The Appointment
programme.desc: 1981. Horror. Director: Lindsey C. Vickers. Stars Edward Woodward, Jane Merrow & Samantha Weysom. Ian misses his daughter's concert so he will have to contend with more than just childish sulking.

programme.title: The Strange Love of Martha Ivers
programme.desc: 1946. Drama. Director: Lewis Milestone. Stars Barbara Stanwyck, Van Heflin, Lizabeth Scott & Kirk Douglas. The relationships formed in childhood by three friends lead to murder and obsessive love.

programme.title: Look At Life The Village Sleeps Again
programme.desc: 1962. A look at the arguments for and against building by-passes, featuring Transport Minister Ernest Marples. With a look at the by-passes being built and the effects on small towns and villages.

programme.title: Stagecoach West
programme.desc: Wayne Rogers & Robert Bray run a stagecoach line in the Old West, where they come across a wide variety of killers, robbers and ladies in distress.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: 1966. Stars Adam West & Burgess Meredith. Suspiciously endearing himself to the citizens of Gotham by foiling a robbery, the Penguin announces he is running for mayor.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: 1966. Stars Adam West, Burgess Meredith & Woodrow Parfrey. The Penguin kidnaps members of the election board in an attempt to sway the votes to become mayor in his favour.

programme.title: The Directors
programme.desc: Alfred Hitchcock defined his own unique style of filmmaking from the early days of the 39 Steps and the Lodger to the Hollywood glamour of North by Northwest.

programme.title: Stock Car
programme.desc: 1955. Drama. After the death of her father while motor racing, the daughter (Rona Anderson) is dissuaded from selling his garage by fellow racer Larry (Paul Carpenter) who helps her run it.

programme.title: Liz Fraser
programme.desc: Desert Mice. Talking Pictures was fortunate to film with Liz Fraser and discuss her life in film a few years ago. Here she talks exclusively to Robert Ross.

programme.title: Desert Mice
programme.desc: 1959. Comedy. Set in WW2, this is the story of an ENSA troupe of entertainers. Starring Sid James, Dora Bryan, Alfred Marks and Liz Fraser.

programme.title: Love In Pawn
programme.desc: 1953. Comedy. Penniless couple Roger (Bernard Braden) and Jean (Barbara Kelly) will get £10,000 if Roger can live a sober and profitable life. Starring Reg Dixon and John Laurie.

programme.title: So Long at the Fair
programme.desc: 1950. Mystery. Directors: Antony Darnborough & Terence Fisher. Stars Jean Simmons & Dirk Bogarde. Two siblings visit Paris for the Great Exhibition of 1889 when one of them goes missing.

programme.title: The Duchess of Duke Street
programme.desc: 1976. Stars Gemma Jones, Christopher Cazenove & Sally Osborne. Everyone is intrigued when an attractive young lady asks to see Lord Haslemere. Who is she and what is she after.

programme.title: The End of the Affair
programme.desc: 1955. Drama. Director: Edward Dmytryk. Stars Deborah Kerr, Van Johnson & John Mills. In WW2 London, a writer falls in love with the wife of a civil servant. Both men suspect her of infidelity.

programme.title: Whispering Smith Hits London
programme.desc: 1952. Mystery. Director: Francis Searle. Stars Richard Carlson, Greta Gynt & Herbert Lom. US sleuth Whispering Smith arrives in London on holiday but soon becomes embroiled in a murder case.

programme.title: Weir's Way
programme.desc: An Edinburgh Volcano. 1981. Tom visits Arthur's Seat in Edinburgh, the most studied volcano in the world and where the very beginnings of geology were laid by Edinburgh geologist James Hutton.

programme.title: The Brothers
programme.desc: 1974. Stars Richard Easton, Bill Treacher & Timothy Carlton. Brian finds himself alone to answer police questioning. Meanwhile, unrest at the depot continues.

programme.title: Mark Saber
programme.desc: 1958. Stars Donald Gray & Neil McCallum. The hero of a children's sci-fi programme on television is a man without enemies, or so he thinks until someone threatens his life.

programme.title: The Wheeltappers and Shunters Social Club
programme.desc: 1975. Julie Rogers performs 'My World Gets Smaller Every Day', and Wild Honey perform 'I Can't Leave You Alone'. Plus, Dustin Gee, Ronnie Dukes and Ricki Lee star.

programme.title: Lord Jim
programme.desc: 1965. Adventure. Directed by Richard Brooks. Stars James Mason, Peter O'Toole & Curt Jurgens. A discredited seaman, desperately seeking to redeem himself, agrees to deliver a dangerous shipment.

programme.title: Planet Weird
programme.desc: Meeting nature's oddballs and mavericks, revealing the bizarre behaviours and ingenious adaptations that help remarkable animals survive.

programme.title: Dawn to Dusk
programme.desc: Spring fever takes hold down under as Australia's animals revel in the first day of the new season. The rising temperatures inspire romance for the koalas, who are imbued with a spirit of rebirth and renewal, while kangaroos box for survival and a surprisingly fast perentie lizard hunts for its weekly meal.

programme.title: Deep Dive Australia
programme.desc: Lizzie Daly takes an in-depth look at the unique and diverse marine life that lives in and around Australia, beginning in the shores of the Northern Territory and the abundant waters of the Great Barrier Reef, facing flooded roads, hungry saltwater crocs ad killer jellyfish.

programme.title: The Big Dry
programme.desc: Zambia's Luangwa Valley endures one of the toughest dry seasons imaginable, but for some animals, the drought brings great opportunity.

programme.title: Orangutan Jungle School
programme.desc: This edition celebrates the new Orangutan Jungle School graduates and cameras follow the convoy to the release site where the team bids their friends a poignant farewell.

programme.title: Surviving the Amazon
programme.desc: The documentary reveals how animals must learn new skills to survive the dry season - and how, if they don't, they'll quickly become the vultures' next feast.

programme.title: Planet Weird
programme.desc: Meeting nature's oddballs and mavericks, revealing the bizarre behaviours and ingenious adaptations that help remarkable animals survive.

programme.title: Tales from Zambia
programme.desc: Following a herd of elephants from sunrise to sunset. In a valley full of life, they encounter many colourful characters, but it all changes when the drought comes.

programme.title: Gladiators
programme.desc: Documentary revealing the secrets and ingenious tactics of nature's toughest fighters in their battles for survival. Narrated by Sean Bean.

programme.title: Wildlife ER

programme.desc: Full of action and drama.

programme.title: De Dana Dan
programme.desc: Two broke friends, eager to marry their girlfriends, hatch a plan to kidnap a rich woman's pet for ransom, but their quick-money scheme soon spirals into chaos.

programme.title: Tanhaji The Unsung Warrior
programme.desc: Tanhaji Malusare, a Maratha leader under Shivaji, fights to seize Kondhana Fort from Rajput commander Udaybhan Rathod, facing strong defense and ruthless obstacles ahead.

programme.title: Inquilaab
programme.desc: A politician helps a jobless man become a police officer but manipulates him for corrupt deeds. When his wife learns he's being exploited as a pawn, she fights to change his path and save him.

programme.title: Guardian

programme.title: Ishq Vishk

programme.title: Mary Kom

programme.title: Yodha

programme.title: xXx: The Next Level
programme.desc: The American secretary of defence forms a covert military organisation with the intention of assassinating the president. A government spymaster is ready to foil the plot but, since his top agent is dead, he has to recruit an imprisoned soldier to help him. Action sequel, starring Ice Cube, Samuel L Jackson and Willem Dafoe.

programme.title: xXx: The Return of Xander Cage
programme.desc: The extreme sports-loving super spy is brought out of exile when a lethal gang of mercenaries steal a powerful new weapon that threatens the safety of the entire world. He must assemble his own team of adrenaline junkie agents to recover the lethal device. Action thriller, starring Vin Diesel, Donnie Yen, Toni Collette and Samuel L Jackson.

programme.title: xXx
programme.desc: Extreme sports star Xander Cage finds himself in trouble when his daredevil exploits land him behind bars. However, he is offered an intriguing escape route, courtesy of National Security Agent Augustus Gibbons - who thinks the adrenaline junkie is the perfect man to bring down a gang of international terrorists in Prague. Action adventure, starring Vin Diesel, Samuel L Jackson, Asia Argento, Marton Csokas and Michael Roof.

Action sequel, starring Ice Cube, Samuel L Jackson and Willem Dafoe.

programme.title: xXx: The Return of Xander Cage
programme.desc: The extreme sports-loving super spy is brought out of exile when a lethal gang of mercenaries steal a powerful new weapon that threatens the safety of the entire world. He must assemble his own team of adrenaline junkie agents to recover the lethal device. Action thriller, starring Vin Diesel, Donnie Yen, Toni Collette and Samuel L Jackson.

programme.title: The Hunger Games
programme.desc: A totalitarian future holds an annual nationally televised event in which two children from each of its regions fight to the death until only one remains. A teenage girl takes her younger sister's place in the games and must pit her wits against the deadly combat skills of her rivals. Sci-fi adventure based on Suzanne Collins' novel, starring Jennifer Lawrence, Josh Hutcherson, Woody Harrelson and Elizabeth Banks.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Catching Fire
programme.desc: Katniss Everdeen's victory in a televised death match makes her a focus for revolution against the totalitarian nation she lives in. The rulers of the regime plot to crush dissent with a new series of games, in which past champions battle it out. Sci-fi adventure sequel based on the second book in Suzanne Collins' trilogy of novels, starring Jennifer Lawrence, Liam Hemsworth, Donald Sutherland and Philip Seymour Hoffman.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay - Part 1
programme.desc: Katniss Everdeen is brought to a secretive underground society following the destruction of the televised deathmatch. She becomes the figurehead of a revolution against the despotic Panem regime, while her friend Peeta remains a captive of its tyrannical president. Part one of the two-part conclusion to the sci-fi adventure series, starring Jennifer Lawrence, Philip Seymour Hoffman, Julianne Moore and Donald Sutherland.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay - Part 2
programme.desc: The civilisation of Panem is consumed by a bloody civil war. Reluctant rebel leader Katniss Everdeen leads a band of her allies on a mission to end the conflict at one stroke by assassinating the despotic President Snow - but faces many dangers as she closes in on her target. Conclusion of the sci-fi adventure series based on Suzanne Collins' novels, starring Jennifer Lawrence, Donald Sutherland and Philip Seymour Hoffman in his final role.
